profile.name: Balaji Chaughule
profile.tagline: BCS student and aspiring backend developer building clean web interfaces, practical dashboards, and API-minded projects in public.
profile.summary: I use every project to improve the fundamentals: readable structure, responsive UI, clear data flow, and dependable implementation habits. My current path is frontend delivery today with steady progress toward backend APIs and service logic.

aboutPoints.title: Learning by building
aboutPoints.text: I turn coursework and self-learning into shipped GitHub projects, with attention to layout, interaction details, and maintainable structure.

aboutPoints.title: Backend curiosity
aboutPoints.text: My focus is moving toward Node.js, Express, REST APIs, data modeling, and server-side logic that is simple to reason about.

aboutPoints.title: Public progress
aboutPoints.text: I keep my progress visible through public repositories so each project shows a clearer version of how I think and build.

projects.title: Tailwind Bundle Files
projects.description: A TypeScript-first Tailwind bundle organized around reusable sections, clean asset structure, and production-style landing page patterns.

projects.title: JSPM College Admission Inquiry
projects.description: A responsive admission inquiry website for a college flow, built with structured sections, Tailwind styling, and JavaScript interactions.

projects.title: Three.js Hand Tracking
projects.description: A browser experiment combining webcam input, hand tracking concepts, full-screen canvas composition, and interactive visual feedback.

projects.title: Cards UI
projects.description: A compact component exercise focused on CSS card systems, spacing rhythm, visual hierarchy, and reusable UI presentation.

projects.title: Headphone Landing Page
projects.description: A product landing page practice project focused on hero composition, visual hierarchy, CSS styling, and focused single-page presentation.

projects.title: Car Landing Page
projects.description: A vehicle-themed landing page showing page structure, hero layout, responsive sections, and core frontend implementation practice.

skillGroups.title: Frontend Foundations
skillGroups.description: Strongest GitHub footprint: static sites, landing pages, dashboards, forms, and responsive page structure.

skillGroups.title: Modern Web Stack
skillGroups.description: Visible in React/Vite apps, TypeScript-heavy Tailwind work, and component-based college and portfolio projects.

skillGroups.title: Tools and Experiments
skillGroups.description: Supporting skills from public repos: SCSS/Bootstrap templates, Three.js experiments, GitHub workflows, and PocketBase exploration.

timeline.title: Aspiring backend developer
timeline.body: Strengthening Node.js, Express, API thinking, and data-flow fundamentals while continuing to publish practical frontend work.

timeline.title: Tailwind bundle and stronger UI structure
timeline.body: Built a TypeScript-heavy Tailwind bundle and improved reusable sections, component spacing, and design consistency.

timeline.title: Frontend project streak on GitHub
timeline.body: Built college, dashboard, restaurant, landing page, and experiment projects using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SCSS, and Tailwind.

timeline.title: Computer science learning path
timeline.body: Studying BCS while using public GitHub work to convert learning into working interfaces and a stronger backend foundation.
